short: Your infrastructure repo as a graph, from the files. Draws Terraform roots, no state needed.
paragraph: behold draws your infrastructure repo as a graph, from the files. Run it in a folder of Terraform and it finds each root and draws it as a box of resources, with an edge for each reference the configuration states. It needs no state file or cloud account, and it runs no terraform binary. It writes nothing into the folder it reads. The same command draws a Pulumi program and the Kubernetes manifests in a plain directory, since their lexicons come with the install. behold works beside the tools a repo already uses.
